authors: Russell G. Wylie, Robert S. Fisher
journal: Journal of Chemical and Engineering Data 41(2), 175-180
title: Molecular Interaction of Water Vapor and Oxygen
experimental_method: Flow saturation method: oxygen passed through a two-stage saturator in a temperature-controlled bath at 25, 50 and 75 C, the water in the gas collected chemically and weighed together with the dried gas (mass of water per mass of oxygen gives x_w and hence f_w).
uncertainties_stated: Uncertainties are 3-sigma (random and systematic summed in quadrature); no uncertainty column for individual f_w values in Table 1; rms difference of the group means from the fitted virial model is 9.8 parts in 10^4 (text, Figure 4).
quality_remarks: Oxygen of commercial purity (0.5-1.0 vol% argon according to supplier, authors infer about 0.4 vol% from the fitted offset); no argon determination made. Table 1 values are means of about five runs each adjusted to nominal conditions, not raw single measurements. Temperature scale not stated.
